The following events took place in '''63 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]]'''.

==Births==
*[[Otto]], future [[General/Legends|general]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and contestant in [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure's]] [[Jabba's demolition games|demolition derby]], was [[Reproduction/Legends|born]].<ref name="Age">In the game manual for ''[[Star Wars: Demolition]]'', General Otto was referred to as a 67-year-old man. The game itself had both [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] (as [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Tamtel Skreej]]) and [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] (as [[Boushh/Legends|Boushh]]) in [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba's]] [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|palace]], which places its events shortly before [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']]. According to ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'', the events of ''Episode VI'' happened in the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]].</ref>
*[[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Korun/Legends|Korun]] [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] first imagines [[Gender/Legends|his]] [[Mace Windu's lightsaber/Legends|future lightsaber]].<ref name="Shatter">[[Shatterpoint (novel)|''Shatterpoint'']]</ref><ref name="Windate">[[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu's]] first conception of [[Gender/Legends|his]] [[Mace Windu's lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] takes place 41 [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before the events of [[Shatterpoint (novel)|''Shatterpoint'']], which ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], 41 years after 63 BBY.</ref>
